annotations.title: A fitness test to run, and what to send back

description: A fitness test a runner can do on their own, from Sigwren: Metabolic Lite (two 20-second sprints and two 6-minute efforts — threshold pace, LT1, VO₂max, VLamax, fat burning and the training zones they set) or a 20- or 30-minute threshold time trial (threshold heart rate and pace, and the zones they set). Use it for "how fit am I", "find my threshold", "set my training zones", "a test I can run". Pass test (metabolic_lite, threshold_20, threshold_30), or leave it out for the list and the default. It returns the session step by step with each step's length and its effort on a 0–10 scale (RPE) in words — tests have no pace to hold, because they are finding it — what the runner needs (a GPS watch; a chest heart-rate strap if they have one), and exactly which numbers to read off the watch afterwards for each effort. The result then comes one of two ways: get_test_upload_link gives a page where the runner uploads the recording (the better way: Sigwren measures the efforts itself), or work_out_my_test takes the numbers they read off the watch. It needs no account and knows nothing about the person.

test.description: Which test: metabolic_lite (the default — threshold pace, LT1, VO₂max, VLamax and fat burning), threshold_20 (a 20-minute time trial — threshold heart rate and pace) or threshold_30 (a 30-minute time trial — the same, for people who prefer the longer one). Leave it out for the list and the default.
